english.title: Fail to comply with request to leave land / remove vehicle from land
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 60C(2)(a) and (5) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to leave the land OR
failed to remove property from the land as soon as reasonably practicable
following a request made by the
occupier / representative of the occupier / constable
under s60C Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by section 83 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 and came in force on the 28th June 2022.
(ii) Section 60C(6) provides defences of reasonable excuse.
(iii) Section 60D makes provision for the seizure and retention of property where a constable reasonably suspects that this offence has been committed.
(iv) Section 60E provides for property forefeiture.
